notes.testing: TSR arm (kingdoms/tsr) of the A/B against the symbolic-regression kingdom: typed_depth Some(2), same seed 7014, same settings, same snapshot binary; only the symbol table's typing differs. Init and point mutation spend the depth budget; the span-moving operators are left to the decode.
notes.outcome: 14,167 generations in 420 s = 29.6 ms/generation against the control's 15,604 at 26.9 -- the ceiling costs 10% of the pace and 9.2% of the generations. 1,638,732 genes refused on type, 9.5% of the 17,245,119 unique genes evaluated; none refused as oversized in either arm. train 1-R2 4.441e-6 against the control's 3.645e-6 (marginally WORSE), validation 1.982e-7 against 4.326e-7 (better); law NOT recovered in either arm, as expected at 800+400. Depth histogram 0:1800 1:1549 2:173 3:48 4:17 5:11 6:2 against the control's 0:641 1:1483 2:1298 3:137 4:16 5:16 6:6 7:3 -- genes past depth 2 fall from 178 (4.9%) to 78 (2.2%) and the tail shortens from 7 to 6, but they do NOT go to zero because a refused gene rides along unscored in a 3-gene chromosome with gene_subsets on. The population also shifts markedly FLATTER inside the legal range: depth 0 rises 641 to 1800 while depth 2 falls 1298 to 173. The reported model is depth-2 legal (sin, sqrt, unnested) where the control's carried cos(sqrt(acos(1/x_1)) + 59), a depth-3 tower.
